heroSubhead: Hi, I'm Ray Maina. Full-stack engineer & native Android developer building high-performance web platforms (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) and AI-powered mobile experiences (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose).

about.paragraph1: I'm a full-stack engineer and native Android specialist. I bridge scalable backend infrastructure with fluid web applications and native Android apps integrated with Generative AI.
about.paragraph2: My web stack centers on React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL/Supabase. On mobile, I build native Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and modern Clean Architecture.

pillars.title: End-to-End
pillars.desc: From database schemas and APIs to web & Android interfaces.

pillars.title: Applied AI
pillars.desc: Gemini multimodal API, streaming tokens & on-device models.

pillars.title: Clean Code
pillars.desc: Strict TypeScript typing, Kotlin coroutines & offline-first reliability.

projects.title: OmniVision AI
projects.tagline: Real-time multimodal object analysis and vision assistant powered by Gemini 1.5.
projects.overview: Native Android vision assistant analyzing live camera feeds and providing real-time AI conversational answers.
projects.challenge: Streaming camera frames to Gemini 1.5 without frame drops in the preview or battery drain.
architecture: CameraX ImageAnalysis pipeline with 2 FPS frame throttling.
MVVM Clean Architecture with Kotlin Coroutines and StateFlow.
Streaming response handling for instant token-by-token visual feedback.

projects.title: PulseStack AI
projects.tagline: Collaborative SaaS knowledge base with automated AI summaries and semantic search.
projects.overview: High-throughput collaborative workspace unifying Markdown notes, vector embeddings, and real-time multi-tab sync.
projects.challenge: Handling concurrent multi-user editing with zero synchronization collisions and sub-50ms query speeds.
architecture: React frontend with strict TypeScript and optimistic UI state updates.
Modular Express.js backend with JWT auth and Row-Level Security (RLS).
Supabase PostgreSQL with pgvector for sub-millisecond semantic search.

projects.title: NexusMetrics
projects.tagline: Real-time telemetry analytics platform ingesting high-throughput application events.
projects.overview: Performance-driven analytics dashboard ingesting telemetry events and rendering interactive 60fps graphs.
projects.challenge: Visualizing high-density time-series data without causing browser UI thread lag.
architecture: Hardware-accelerated Canvas rendering with virtualized data downsampling.
PostgreSQL continuous aggregates and materialized view cron refreshes.
Event ingester with backpressure handling for traffic spikes.

projects.title: AuraHealth
projects.tagline: Offline-first native Android wellness tracker with Google Health Connect sync.
projects.overview: Privacy-first Android health monitoring app integrating Google Health Connect with offline-first local storage.
projects.challenge: Performing periodic background biometric syncs without battery drain or OEM task termination.
architecture: Declarative Jetpack Compose UI following Material 3 guidelines.
WorkManager with constrained execution criteria (charging, network connected).
Encrypted local Room database with SQLCipher.

experience.desc: Architecting production web apps and native Android AI applications.
Engineered backend APIs with Node.js and Supabase, building real-time dashboards.
Built native Android apps with Kotlin, MVVM architecture, and Room database caching.
